findings.evidence: Two extra iron fittings with hinge knuckles flank the central latch, so the chest has more hinges than the two back-edge hinges the spec calls for.
The front-left and front-right fittings have pivot barrels at the lid seam, hinging the lid at the front as well as the back so it could not open.
